Class ClientGameState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.network.client.ClientGameState
public class ClientGameState extends Object
Client-side replica of the game state, built from a GameSnapshot and updated incrementally via GameDelta objects received from the server. The view (GUI or TUI) reads this state to render the game.

Fields mirror the server-side game: board rows, offer track, turn order, player states, current phase or turn or era and end-game results.
